text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein, Egyptian President Mubarak to discuss on Saturday salvaging peace process; Israeli-Palestinian-Jordanian summit expected before end of week.
- Israel agrees to pump 30 million cubic metres of drinking water from Sea of Galilee to Jordan by middle of week under accord to resolve water row.
- Crown Prince Hassan says Islam is religion of tolerance and calls for co-existence; stresses need to respect legitimate rights of Palestinians
- Heads of professional unions decide on Saturday whether to submit mass resignations or freeze them in protest at new press law.
- Information minister says Egyptian-Jordanian summit will also tackle developments in Iraq.
- Head of Journalists Union denies prior knowledge of new press law which imposes tougher restrictions on reporting before it was enacted as royal decree.
